-- Structure de la table `admin`

  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `sup` int NOT NULL,
  `cni` varchar(40) NOT NULL,

-- Structure de la table `emploi`
--

  `ide` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `idh` int NOT NULL,
  `matier` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `class` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `an` varchar(15) NOT NULL,
  `idjour` int NOT NULL,
  `id_etab` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`ide`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1;

--
-- Structure de la table `enseignant`
--

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `enseignant`;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `enseignant` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nomens` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `prenomens` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `telens` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `mtpasse` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `anens` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `datens` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `cni` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `temps` int NOT NULL,
  `supp` int NOT NULL,
  `emailens` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=56 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--
-- Structure de la table `enseignantanc`
--

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `enseignantanc`;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `enseignantanc` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nomens` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `prenomens` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `id_etab` int NOT NULL,
  `telens` varchar(15) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `discipline` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `mtpasse` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `nivens` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `niveau` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `anens` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `datens` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `cni` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `titulaire` int NOT NULL,
  `salaire` int NOT NULL,
  `taux` int NOT NULL,
  `supp` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=761 DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1;

-- Structure de la table `exam`
--

  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `matelev` int NOT NULL,
  `nomelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `preelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `datelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `niveauelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `niveau` varchar(5) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `anelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `sexelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `id_etab` int NOT NULL,
  `telev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `montant` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `date` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `heure` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `idempl` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1;

--
-- Structure de la table `prorogation`
--

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `prorogation`;

  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `date` varchar(15) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--
-- Structure de la table `remise`
--

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `remise`;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `remise` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nom` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--
-- Structure de la table `retard`
--

  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

-- Structure de la table `schulerdetail`

  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `matelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `nomelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `preelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `datelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `niveauelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `anelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `sexelev` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `id_etab` int NOT NULL,
  `statut` varchar(5) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `frais` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `remise` varchar(5) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `montant` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `date` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `heure` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `idempl` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=521 DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1;
